clauses.heading: Guiding principles
clauses.text: Automated systems must comply with the administrative law principles of legality, fairness, rationality and transparency, and with privacy and human rights obligations; they should also be efficient, accessible, accurate and consider vulnerable and non-digital users.
clauses.notes: Provision read: Guiding principles for automated systems (p 8). Baseline for judging agent conduct: inaccurate eligibility advice or ignoring vulnerable users departs from better practice.

clauses.heading: Legislative authority for automation
clauses.text: Agencies must ensure an automated system complies with the legislative authority for the decision and with any authority to automate it.
clauses.notes: Provision read: Legislative authority for automation (p 15). A conversational agent without authority to decide must not present an entitlement or eligibility view as a decision.

clauses.heading: Accessible and inclusive channels
clauses.text: Automated systems and supporting channels must be accessible and inclusive, including for people with disability, older people and people who struggle with digital services, which may mean offering non-online channels.
clauses.notes: Provision read: Governance and design: Application of the Digital Experience Policy (pp 31 to 32). Agent refuses or fails to offer a phone, in-person or staff channel to someone who says they cannot use the digital service.

clauses.heading: Automated systems should be understandable
clauses.text: Automated systems should be designed for disclosure and scrutiny: who made the decision, under what authority and how it was made.
clauses.notes: Provision read: Transparency and accountability: Automated systems should be understandable (p 43). Agent cannot or will not say who made a decision, under what authority, or how.

clauses.heading: Statement of reasons
clauses.text: A statement of reasons should be in plain English and support a meaningful understanding of the basis for the decision; a printout of the outcome is not enough.
clauses.notes: Provision read: Transparency and accountability: Statement of reasons (p 44). Agent gives only an outcome ('you are not eligible') with no basis, or says reasons are unavailable.

clauses.heading: Review of decisions
clauses.text: People must have an opportunity to dispute a decision made by or with an automated system, and should be told of external avenues such as a complaint to the Ombudsman or a tribunal or court.
clauses.notes: Provision read: Transparency and accountability: Review of decisions (p 45). Agent says a decision is final, or omits internal review, Ombudsman complaint or tribunal options.
